additional_info.subject: Firmware Update Failure via SCB – Charging Stations 170002069 & 170002071
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I am attempting to update the firmware for the following charging stations:
170002069
170002071
Each time I initiate the firmware download via SCB, the update process fails. The charging stations do not complete the file download, which prevents the firmware update from proceeding.
Please note that these two stations are installed next to each other, and each SIM card has a 100 GB data plan. Therefore, the issue does not appear to be related to data consumption. It may be related to a backend or AWS-related issue.
Could you please investigate this matter? If it is possible for you to perform the firmware update remotely, I would appreciate it if you could proceed accordingly.
Thank you for your support.
Best regards,
Orel Lachiani
GSW Integration Engineer & E-Mobility Expert
